items.1: 1. This tool is intended only for authorized accounts and must not be used for unauthorized access, disruption, or bypassing platform restrictions.
items.2: 2. Users are responsible for safeguarding accounts, tokens, BIN files, and other sensitive data, and for the outcomes of their usage.
items.3: 3. Automation, data display, and download capabilities are provided as assistive tools and are not guaranteed to be continuously available or completely error-free.
items.4: 4. If abnormal calls, invite-code abuse, or behavior affecting other users is detected, administrators may suspend or close the account.

items.1: 1. During registration and sign-in, the system stores usernames, email addresses, sign-in time, and necessary authentication data for account identification and security control.
items.2: 2. Uploaded BIN files, preference settings, and task data are used only for the current account and are not shared with other users by default.
items.3: 3. Remote BIN downloads are disabled by default. The system allows downloading backend-stored files only after the user enables this setting in Profile.
items.4: 4. To delete account data or handle sensitive information issues, please contact the administrator.

beginner.title: Newcomer
beginner.description: Just entered the martial world and still finding footing.

known.title: Recognized
known.description: Has earned some fame and a place in the world.

veteran.title: Seasoned
veteran.description: Battle-tested and steadily becoming a real force.

master.title: Renowned
master.description: Refined skills and a name known across the region.

hero.title: Heroic
hero.description: Bold and mighty, commanding respect far and wide.

overlord.title: Overlord
overlord.description: Gifted in both strength and strategy, shaping the battlefield.

supreme.title: Supreme
supreme.description: Power beyond measure, looked up to by all.

emperor.title: Emperor
emperor.description: At the peak of influence, able to command the realm.

infinite.title: Infinite
infinite.description: Beyond legend itself, unmatched by anyone.

hero.title: Fold repetitive operations into one clear control surface
hero.subtitle: Roles, tasks, data, and events all connect in one place. You set the strategy, and the system handles the repetition.

mockup.title: Bring scattered status into one panel
mockup.subtitle: Role status, task progress, and key reminders stay in the same view, so you do not need to keep switching pages.

stepUp.title: Admin-sensitive actions require another confirmation
stepUp.description: High-risk operations such as create, disable, and delete must be confirmed again before they run.

codes.title: Invite and activation codes are shown only once
codes.description: They can be copied when created, and the list view falls back to masked content afterward.

audit.title: Key security actions keep a detailed audit trail
audit.description: Security setting changes, admin actions, and sensitive reads are all recorded.

sections.featuresSubtitle: A complete daily operations toolkit, from execution to review, all in one flow.

workflow.sectionTitle: The main flow from import to execution
workflow.sectionSubtitle: The hero only shows the outcome. The actual operating flow moves to the next section so the page feels lighter.

import.title: Import and Bind
import.description: Import Token and BIN first, then bind the account identity and activation context.

activate.title: Establish Secure Context
activate.description: Use step-up verification, session checks, and activation validation before allowing execution.

execute.title: Open Tasks and Panels
execute.description: Game features, task control, and admin operations are only exposed after the required checks pass.

roleHub.title: Role Hub
roleHub.description: Unified health checks across multiple accounts

snapshots.title: Data Snapshots
snapshots.description: Review key progress and fluctuations in real time

roleManagement.title: Role Management
roleManagement.description: Manage multiple game roles in one place with quick switching, aggregated state, and key status monitoring.

taskAutomation.title: Task Automation
taskAutomation.description: Turn repetitive actions into workflows that run automatically and produce traceable results.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Capture key metrics and quickly spot gains, regressions, and abnormal changes.

personalization.title: Personalized Configuration
personalization.description: Define strategy parameters by role and scenario to build your own operations console.

security.title: Account protections already built into this version
security.subtitle: These are not promises on paper. They are protections already active in the system, even during the current test phase.

mfa.title: Important actions need another confirmation
mfa.description: Actions related to account safety and key data do not run immediately. The system asks for another confirmation first.

codes.title: Sensitive information is not left fully visible
codes.description: Pages try to show masked values by default, so full details are not sitting on screen for anyone to read at a glance. Viewing or operating on them may require another confirmation.

runtime.title: Abnormal sign-ins are easier to block
runtime.description: Sign-in, session refresh, and sensitive actions now go through more checks, which reduces the chance of an account continuing to be used in an abnormal state.

csp.title: The web app is allowed to do less by default
csp.description: The browser is more tightly limited on which scripts can run and which addresses pages can connect to, especially on admin screens.
